# Mailshift

Private, local-first email migration tracker.

## What this repo is

- Tracks account changes when moving from one email address to another.
- Uses a browser-only encrypted vault.
- Rejects credential-bearing imports.
- Exports encrypted backups and completion CSVs.

## Key commands

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1
npm run update:sites
npm run check
npm run build
npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1
```

## Example data

- [50-service Gmail to Proton sample CSV](examples/gmail-to-proton.csv)

## Important behavior

- No backend.
- No mailbox access.
- No automatic login.
- No password storage.
- Local data is encrypted in browser storage.
- 100 source-linked playbooks provide reviewed guides.
- 5,000 additional domains provide recognition and generic workflow without a
  verified-guide claim.
